name: Contribution Score
summary: Scores users by the comments they write in the Deep Funding Portal.
description:
### What it does
Measures the quality and impact of each user's comments in the Deep Funding Portal.

### How it works
- Reputo identifies each user by their decentralized identifier (DID).
- Each valid comment starts with a base score.
- Upvotes add points, and downvotes remove points.
- Comments on your own proposal and replies to your own comments can receive a penalty.
- An upvote from the proposal owner can add a bonus.
- Older comments can lose value over time.

### Data used
Proposal, comment, user, and vote data from the Deep Funding Portal.

### Results
- A CSV file with `did` and `contribution_score`.
- A JSON file with score details for each user and comment.

inputs.label: Base points per comment
inputs.description: Points a valid comment receives before votes, bonuses, penalties, and monthly score reduction.

inputs.label: Points per upvote
inputs.description: How much one upvote increases the comment score.

inputs.label: Points per downvote
inputs.description: How much one downvote reduces the comment score.

inputs.label: Self-interaction penalty
inputs.description: Multiplier for comments on your own proposal and replies to your own comments. Use `1` to turn off this penalty.

inputs.label: Proposal owner upvote bonus
inputs.description: Multiplier used when the proposal owner upvotes a comment. Use `1` to turn off this bonus.

inputs.label: Time period (months)
inputs.description: Number of previous months of comments to include.

inputs.label: Monthly score reduction (%)
inputs.description: Percentage removed from a comment's score for each month of age. Use `0` to keep older scores unchanged.

outputs.label: Contribution score (CSV)
outputs.description: One row per user with their final contribution score.

columns.description: Final user score. It is not adjusted to a fixed range, so the range depends on the included comments.

outputs.label: Contribution score details (JSON)
outputs.description: Score details for each user and comment.
